name: natural-spacing-spec-workspace
description: Specification and conformance fixtures for IME-safe Han–Latin input spacing.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:repository && node scripts/validate-spec.mjs && npm run validate:unicode
scripts.test:web: npm run build:core && npm run build:web && node --test packages/typescript/web/test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:core && npm run build:web && npm run build:test:browser-fixtures && playwright test --config=playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:consumer:npm: npm run build:core && npm run build:web && node scripts/test-npm-consumer.mjs
scripts.test: npm run validate && npm run test:core && npm run test:web && npm run test:asr
